# Third-party assets

Brimholt's own art is generated by `tools/generators/make_sprites.py`. The only third-party
assets are listed here. Only CC0 (public domain) assets are allowed, except the DejaVu Sans font (free Bitstream Vera
licence, allowed by the owner on 2026-10-17) and the OpenTibia sprite pack (CC BY 4.0, allowed by the owner on
2026-10-21 as models for our own variants, never shipped as-is); never import ripped,
proprietary, or Tibia-derived art. Keep each pack's original license file beside it.

| Pack | Author | License | Source | Files used | Changes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Particle Pack 1.1 | Kenney (kenney.nl) | CC0 1.0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/particle-pack | `kenney_particle_pack/`: light_01, circle_05, spark_04, star_06, smoke_04, magic_03, slash_02, flare_01 | Downscaled from 512 to 128 px |
| OpenTibia sprite pack | The OpenTibia community (`opentibia_sprite_pack/AUTHORS.md`) | CC BY 4.0 | https://github.com/peonso/opentibia_sprite_pack | `opentibia_sprite_pack/otsp_equipment_01.png`, `LICENSE.txt`, `AUTHORS.md` (read by `tools/generators/pack_legwear.py`) | Leg models repainted in our own materials and layout and re-detailed into Brimholt variants (`pack_sprites.variant`), one design per model |
| DejaVu Sans 2.37 | DejaVu fonts team, based on Bitstream Vera | Bitstream Vera licence (DejaVu changes public domain) | https://github.com/dejavu-fonts/dejavu-fonts/releases/tag/version_2_37 | `fonts/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf`, `fonts/dejavu/LICENSE` | None |

The OpenTibia sprite pack is CC BY 4.0: keep this row and its AUTHORS.md as the attribution.

Credit to Kenney is appreciated but not required by CC0.
